title: Warehouse user validates the receipt of an approved purchase order: the order reads fully received
_seedNote: the receipt comes from an approved purchase order (J-PURCH-02 approves 12 Desk Combinations from Gemini)

seeds.name: receiptNo
seeds.sql: SELECT t.Number AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Status = 'Ready' AND t/Inventory.Transfer_OperationType/Inventory.OperationType/Kind = 'Receipt' AND t/Inventory.Transfer_PurchaseOrder/Purchasing.PurchaseOrder/Number != NULL ORDER BY t.Number DESC LIMIT 1

seeds.name: orderNo
seeds.sql: SELECT t/Inventory.Transfer_PurchaseOrder/Purchasing.PurchaseOrder/Number AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Number = '{{receiptNo}}'

steps.name: Open Inventory > Transfers and the receipt

outcome.label: the purchase order reads fully received
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.ID) AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrder AS o WHERE o.Number = '{{orderNo}}' AND o.ReceiptStatus = 'FullyReceived'
